hook: What if Iguazú Falls hit 17,700 m³/s, twelve times normal?

sections.voiceover: What if Iguazú Falls hit 17,700 m³/s, twelve times normal?
On 26 Oct 2026 the ANA gauge at Iguazú River logged a record 17,700 m³/s flow. Why did officials close the Upper Circuit walkway for tourists?
But the record on 12 Oct was 11,831 m³/s, shy of the later peak.

The 17,700 m³/s surge became the decade’s highest at Iguazú Falls. Officials closed the Upper Circuit walkway, stopping all tourist traffic. That flow was nearly twelve times the 1,500 m³/s average, eclipsing the 11,831 m³/s of 12 Oct.
Iguazú Falls peaked at 17,700 m³/s on 26 Oct 2026.
